laws_and_bills.name: LD 307 data center moratorium and coordination council
laws_and_bills.what: Would have paused state and municipal permits for data centers with loads of 20 MW or more until 2027-11-01 and created a 13-member council to study siting and impacts. Passed both chambers; vetoed by Gov. Mills 2026-04-24 (no exemption for the Jay project); House override failed 72-65 on 2026-04-29.

laws_and_bills.name: LD 713
laws_and_bills.what: Signed by Gov. Mills: bars data center projects from the state's business development tax incentive programs.

laws_and_bills.name: Planned executive order creating a data center study council
laws_and_bills.what: Gov. Mills said she intends to issue an executive order creating a council to study data center impacts in Maine.

laws_and_bills.name: Executive Order 5 FY 25/26: Maine Data Center Advisory Council
laws_and_bills.what: Signed 2026-04-29. Creates the council; DOER to work with the PUC on ratepayer protections (supply costs, overbuild risk). Final report due about 2027-01-29.

incentives.name: Exclusion of data centers from business tax incentives
incentives.what: Data center projects cannot use Maine's business development tax incentive programs.

dockets.what: Inquiry into existing processes for serving large data centers, opened after DOER's 2026-05-20 letter asking the PUC to gather information (per Data Center Advisory Council materials). Scope and schedule not confirmed.
